clauses.title: Annual leave
clauses.text: Annual leave, formerly called holiday entitlement: full-time staff earn 20 days of annual leave each calendar year. Part-time staff earn annual leave pro rata to contracted hours.
clauses.answer: Full-time staff earn 20 days of annual leave a year; part-time staff earn it pro rata.

clauses.title: Holiday entitlement
clauses.text: Holiday entitlement: every employee receives 18 days holiday entitlement each year. Holiday entitlement days are added on 1 April.
clauses.answer: Every employee receives 18 days of holiday entitlement a year, added on 1 April.

clauses.title: Carrying leave over
clauses.text: Up to 5 unused annual leave days carry over into the next calendar year and must be taken by 31 March. Days above 5 lapse unless HR agrees an exception in writing.
clauses.answer: Up to 5 unused days carry over and must be taken by 31 March; the rest lapse.

clauses.title: Carry forward
clauses.text: Unused holiday can be carried forward: up to 10 unused holiday days carry forward to the next year and must be used by 30 June.
clauses.answer: Up to 10 unused holiday days carry forward and must be used by 30 June.

clauses.title: Sick leave
clauses.text: Staff receive 14 days of paid sick leave each calendar year. A medical certificate is required for any sickness absence longer than 2 consecutive working days.
clauses.answer: You get 14 days of paid sick leave a year; a medical certificate is needed after 2 consecutive working days.

clauses.title: Parental leave
clauses.text: The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of paid parental leave after a birth or adoption. The secondary caregiver receives 4 weeks of paid parental leave, taken within 12 months.
clauses.answer: Primary caregivers get 16 weeks of paid parental leave, secondary caregivers 4 weeks within 12 months.

clauses.title: Compassionate leave
clauses.text: Compassionate leave of 3 paid days is granted on the death of an immediate family member: spouse, child, parent or sibling. Managers may grant 2 further days.
clauses.answer: You get 3 paid days of compassionate leave for an immediate family bereavement; your manager may add 2.

clauses.title: Requesting leave
clauses.text: Request leave in the HR portal. Requests for more than 3 consecutive days must be made at least 10 working days ahead, and your line manager approves or declines within 3 working days.
clauses.answer: Request leave in the HR portal; blocks over 3 days need 10 working days' notice and manager approval.

clauses.title: Working from home
clauses.text: Staff may work from home up to 2 days a week with their line manager's agreement. Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 Singapore time on every working day, at home or in the office.
clauses.answer: You may work from home up to 2 days a week with your manager's agreement; core hours are 10:00 to 16:00.

clauses.title: Remote work
clauses.text: Remote work: employees may take up to 3 remote work days per week. Remote work days are agreed with the team each month.
clauses.answer: You may take up to 3 remote work days per week, agreed with your team monthly.

clauses.title: Working abroad
clauses.text: Working temporarily from another country needs written HR approval before travel, and is limited to 10 working days in a calendar year because of tax and immigration rules.
clauses.answer: Working from another country needs HR approval first and is capped at 10 working days a year.

clauses.title: Pay day
clauses.text: Salary is paid monthly on the 25th. When the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday, salary is paid on the previous working day. Payslips are published in the HR portal.
clauses.answer: Salaries are paid on the 25th, or the working day before; payslips are in the HR portal.

clauses.title: Salary bands
clauses.text: Salary bands by grade, 2025: grade 5 SGD 48,000 to 62,000; grade 6 SGD 60,000 to 78,000; grade 7 SGD 76,000 to 98,000; grade 8 SGD 95,000 to 125,000 base salary a year.
clauses.answer: Grade 7 base salary band is SGD 76,000 to 98,000 a year.

clauses.title: Overtime
clauses.text: Non-exempt staff are paid overtime at 1.5 times the hourly rate for hours above 44 a week. Overtime must be approved by the line manager in advance and is paid with the next month's salary.
clauses.answer: Non-exempt staff get 1.5x for hours above 44 a week, approved in advance and paid next month.

clauses.title: Salary review
clauses.text: Managers submit salary increase recommendations in the annual review cycle in March. Off-cycle increases need HR business partner and finance approval with a written business case.
clauses.answer: Salary increases go through the March review; off-cycle increases need HR and finance approval.

clauses.title: Performance improvement plan
clauses.text: Before starting a performance improvement plan, the manager must consult the HR business partner. A performance improvement plan lasts 8 weeks with fortnightly written reviews.
clauses.answer: Consult your HR business partner first; a performance improvement plan lasts 8 weeks with fortnightly reviews.

clauses.title: Disciplinary hearing
clauses.text: An employee invited to a disciplinary hearing receives written notice 5 working days before, and may bring a colleague or union representative as a companion.
clauses.answer: You get 5 working days' written notice and may bring a colleague or union representative.

clauses.title: Probation
clauses.text: New employees serve a probation period of 3 months. The notice period during probation is 1 week from either side; after confirmation it follows the employment contract.
clauses.answer: Probation is 3 months with 1 week's notice; after confirmation your contract's notice applies.

clauses.title: Employee referral bonus
clauses.text: Staff who refer a candidate who is hired receive a referral bonus of SGD 1,000, paid after the new hire completes probation. Hiring managers are not eligible for their own vacancies.
clauses.answer: A successful referral earns SGD 1,000, paid once the new hire completes probation.

clauses.title: Opening a vacancy
clauses.text: To open a new headcount vacancy, the hiring manager submits a requisition with a finance sign-off. Replacement vacancies need only the department head's approval.
clauses.answer: New headcount needs a requisition with finance sign-off; replacements need the department head.

clauses.title: Gifts and hospitality
clauses.text: Gifts or hospitality from customers or suppliers worth more than SGD 100 must be declared in the gifts register within 5 working days. Cash gifts must always be refused.
clauses.answer: Declare gifts or hospitality over SGD 100 within 5 working days; never accept cash.

clauses.title: Conflicts of interest
clauses.text: Declare any conflict of interest, such as a family member (spouse, parent, brother or sister) who works for a supplier, or a second job, to your manager and in the conflicts register before taking part in the related decision.
clauses.answer: Declare conflicts of interest to your manager and in the register before the related decision.

clauses.title: Passwords
clauses.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Passwords no longer expire on a schedule; change your password only if you suspect it is compromised, and never reuse a work password elsewhere.
clauses.answer: Use at least 14 characters; passwords do not expire, change it only if you suspect compromise.

clauses.title: Password change
clauses.text: Change your password every 90 days. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and the system blocks your last 5 passwords.
clauses.answer: Change your password every 90 days; at least 12 characters.

clauses.title: Multi-factor authentication
clauses.text: Multi-factor authentication is required for email, the VPN and every finance system. Register the authenticator app on your phone; lost phones are reported to the IT service desk.
clauses.answer: MFA is required for email, VPN and finance systems; register the authenticator app.

clauses.title: Account lockout and reset
clauses.text: After 5 failed sign-in attempts your account locks for 15 minutes. Reset a forgotten password yourself in the self-service password portal, or call the IT service desk.
clauses.answer: Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failures; reset in the self-service password portal.

clauses.title: Laptop refresh
clauses.text: Company laptops are refreshed every 4 years. Request an earlier replacement through an IT ticket if the laptop fails or no longer runs required software.
clauses.answer: Laptops are refreshed every 4 years; raise an IT ticket for an early replacement.

clauses.title: Lost or stolen devices
clauses.text: Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to IT security within 1 hour on the security hotline, so the device can be locked and wiped remotely.
clauses.answer: Report a lost or stolen device to IT security within 1 hour on the security hotline.

clauses.title: Personal phones
clauses.text: Personal phones may access company email and chat only after the device management app is installed. Company files must not be stored on personal devices.
clauses.answer: Personal phones can use email and chat only with the device management app installed.

clauses.title: Installing software
clauses.text: Install software only from the company software catalogue. For anything not in the catalogue, raise an IT ticket with a business justification; IT security reviews it within 5 working days.
clauses.answer: Install only from the software catalogue; request anything else by IT ticket with a justification.

clauses.title: External AI tools
clauses.text: Do not paste confidential or restricted data, including customer shipment records, into external AI tools. Public information may be used in the approved AI tools listed in the catalogue.
clauses.answer: Never paste confidential data, such as shipment records, into external AI tools; use the approved ones.

clauses.title: Phishing
clauses.text: Report a suspicious email with the Report phishing button in your mail client. Do not click links or open attachments; if you already clicked, call the security hotline at once.
clauses.answer: Use the Report phishing button; if you already clicked, call the security hotline.

clauses.title: Data breach
clauses.text: If you suspect personal data has been lost or exposed, report it to the data protection officer within 24 hours. The data protection officer decides whether regulators must be notified.
clauses.answer: Report a suspected personal data breach to the data protection officer within 24 hours.

clauses.title: Local admin rights
clauses.text: Local administrator rights on a laptop are granted for 24 hours through a privileged access request, approved by the IT security manager, and every session is logged.
clauses.answer: Local admin rights are granted for 24 hours via a privileged access request approved by IT security.

clauses.title: Firewall exceptions
clauses.text: Firewall rule exceptions need a change request, a named business owner and an expiry date no later than 90 days, reviewed at the weekly change board.
clauses.answer: Firewall exceptions need a change request, an owner and an expiry within 90 days.

clauses.title: Submitting expense claims
clauses.text: Submit expense claims in the expenses app within 30 days of the expense date, with an itemised receipt for every item over SGD 25. Late claims need the financial controller's approval.
clauses.answer: Submit claims within 30 days with itemised receipts over SGD 25; late claims need approval.

clauses.title: Expense claim deadline
clauses.text: Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days. Attach a receipt for each expense claim item over SGD 50.
clauses.answer: Submit expense claims within 60 days, with receipts over SGD 50.

clauses.title: Meals when travelling
clauses.text: When travelling on business, meals are covered by a daily allowance of SGD 60 in Singapore and up to SGD 90 abroad, claimed without receipts. Alcohol is never reimbursed.
clauses.answer: Meals on business travel are covered by a daily allowance of SGD 60 in Singapore, up to SGD 90 abroad.

clauses.title: Per diem
clauses.text: Per diem for meals when travelling: SGD 50 per day in Singapore and SGD 70 per day abroad. Keep the per diem receipts.
clauses.answer: The meal per diem is SGD 50 a day in Singapore and SGD 70 abroad.

clauses.title: Client entertainment
clauses.text: Client entertainment up to SGD 150 per guest needs no approval in advance. Above that, get your director's approval first and list every guest's name and company on the claim.
clauses.answer: Client entertainment up to SGD 150 per guest is fine; above that, get director approval first.

clauses.title: Flight class
clauses.text: Book economy class for flights under 6 hours. Business class is allowed for flights of 6 hours or more with director approval. All flights are booked through the travel desk.
clauses.answer: Economy under 6 hours; business class from 6 hours with director approval, via the travel desk.

clauses.title: Business class
clauses.text: Business class flights are permitted when the flight is longer than 8 hours. Book business class flights through the travel agent.
clauses.answer: Business class is permitted on flights longer than 8 hours.

clauses.title: Hotels
clauses.text: Hotel rates are capped at SGD 250 a night in Asia and SGD 350 a night elsewhere, booked through the travel desk. Staying with friends earns no allowance.
clauses.answer: Hotels are capped at SGD 250 a night in Asia and SGD 350 elsewhere, via the travel desk.

clauses.title: Quotes for purchases
clauses.text: Purchases over SGD 5,000 need three written quotes from different suppliers. Purchases over SGD 50,000 go to a tender run by procurement.
clauses.answer: Over SGD 5,000 you need three written quotes; over SGD 50,000 procurement runs a tender.

clauses.title: Purchase orders
clauses.text: Raise a purchase order in the finance system before the supplier starts work. Invoices without a matching purchase order are returned to the supplier unpaid.
clauses.answer: Raise a purchase order before the supplier starts work; invoices without one are returned.

clauses.title: Corporate cards
clauses.text: Corporate cards are for business expenses only, never personal use. Reconcile your corporate card statement in the expenses app by the 5th of each month.
clauses.answer: Corporate cards are business-only; reconcile your statement by the 5th of each month.

clauses.title: Spending limits
clauses.text: Delegated spending limits: team managers approve spend up to SGD 10,000; directors up to SGD 100,000; the chief financial officer up to SGD 500,000; above that, the board.
clauses.answer: Managers approve up to SGD 10,000, directors SGD 100,000, the CFO SGD 500,000, above that the board.

clauses.title: Supplier payment terms
clauses.text: Suppliers are paid 30 days after the end of the invoice month. Early payment of a supplier invoice needs the chief financial officer's approval and a recorded reason.
clauses.answer: Suppliers are paid 30 days after month end; early payment needs CFO approval.

clauses.title: Month-end close
clauses.text: Month-end close timetable: accruals posted by working day 3, intercompany balances agreed by working day 4, and management accounts issued on working day 6.
clauses.answer: Accruals by working day 3, intercompany by day 4, management accounts on day 6.
